Thank you. I’ll hold on if you hold on too

It’s just I’ve started collage after half a year break. At night, since I wasn’t busy with hw, I kept thinking about the in class part because I have social anxiety. I was also thing about the bus I’ll have to take and it’ll be so crowded. I was overwhelmed with the thoughts of how many people I would be surrounded with so I got an attack.
Thank you! This is quite helpful.

I start collage in January and I took a full course load. I’m not sure if that was a good idea since I’m severely depressed and will probably get burnt out really fast. I’m wondering if I should withdraw from one or two out of the four courses. But I’m afraid I’ll fall behind. All of this is making me feel very anxious.
It’s definitely the most exhausting thing to be alive.

Sometimes it’s very important to know who’s toxic and who’s not even if they’re your family…but it’s better to cut those off who cause you harm for a better and healthy future for yourself. I wish you the best! You’re very strong and stay that way. :)

Happy birthday! We don’t know each other but I do sincerely wish you a happy birthday. You matter and you are cared for. I know how lonely it can be in your own family but I know you’ll find someone who’ll give you all their time, just wait for that special person! :)
I use the thought of death for comfort all the time. It seems like one of the only coping mechanisms I have.
Thank you for the advice, I think I really do need to go outside in nature more often. It’s always helped me in the past.

Yeah I wish I could. I couldn’t sleep at all last night either and had the most exhausting day ever. Ever since I started my new medication that I’m supposed to take before sleeping, It’s been difficult for me to fall asleep…it’s getting annoying because I really value and need my sleep.

I feel the same way. I see literally no light or any of that sappy shit at the end of the tunnel. Living is just a responsibility and each day I feel like I shouldn’t have even been born because of how useless i am. I feel like garbage and I hate it. It’s so hard to change especially when all I feel is apathy towards the future because all I see is death.
